why_this_is_not_success: The result proves shared-state alignment only.
The result does not prove sensor inventory.
The result does not prove camera cycling.
The result does not prove human detection.
The result does not prove TTS interaction.
The result does not prove human memory or Dave primary-operator binding.
The result does not prove object identification or unknown-object inquiry.

learning_objective.title: Do not treat state-bus or alignment validation as lab-awareness execution
learning_objective.lesson: For physical/lab objectives, success must be grounded in fresh world-facing evidence. Shared-state alignment and bridge health are prerequisites, not completion.
learning_objective.validation: Completion is forbidden until every required lab-awareness artifact exists and has timestamps after this correction.

required_resolution.first_runtime_action: MIM inventories available lab cameras and microphones and publishes MIM_LAB_SENSOR_INVENTORY.latest.json, or publishes blocked_with_inspection naming the exact resource access blocker.
